facts.fact: The article 'ChatGPT x Local SEO Masterclass' by Merchynt is dated February 8, 2023.
Merchynt states that its free ChatGPT Local SEO Optimization Prompt generates a customized local SEO marketing plan in 10 seconds (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: to get a customized local SEO marketing plan in 10 seconds

facts.fact: Merchynt states that its free ChatGPT content calendar prompt produces an automated social media content posting calendar for a user's keywords in 10 seconds (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: With our ChatGPT prompt, you can get an automated social media content posting calendar for your keywords in 10 seconds flat.

facts.fact: Merchynt's free ChatGPT Google Business Post prompt is described as producing ten SEO-optimized Google Business Post ideas for any business (vendor's own description).
facts.quote: come up with ten great SEO-optimized Google Business Post ideas for any business

facts.fact: Merchynt says all responses from its free ChatGPT Google Business Profile Optimizer prompt are 100% optimized for the client's local SEO target keywords (vendor's own claim, not independently verified).
facts.quote: All responses are 100% optimized for your client's local SEO target keywords.
